title: Eleven Months Open
subtitle: 交流与沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交流与沟通（社会服务与人际沟通·语言与交流）
meta: 主题语境：交流与沟通（社会服务与人际沟通·语言与交流）　|　核心词汇：communication　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 communication 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 my father ① opened communication with a brother he had not written to in nine years, and he said the opening was the whole of the letter. The ② communication, meaning the exchange and not the paper, took eleven months and stayed open; communication, he said, is the only thing between two houses that is judged by how long it stays open.

Every ③ communication on that line had the same delay, and the ④ communication at the end, meaning the one he kept for the bad news and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever read twice. Communication, my mother said, is nine parts waiting and one part somebody willing to write back; my father said the waiting is the part that fills the year.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ communication was the whole of the road, meaning the cables and not the letters. The ⑥ communication, meaning the cables and not any of that, is the only thing in a valley that everybody uses and nobody sees; communication, he said, is either something you open or the only word that means both a letter and a set of cables. She said the cables are the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ communication had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the delay. The ⑧ communication of the whole thing, my father wrote in May, was one letter and thirty years of waiting; communication, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to write back. He said the writing back was never mentioned.

The ⑨ communication I remember is the one at the end, which arrived in 1975 and is still described as the shortest in the valley. A ⑩ communication, my mother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being answered; every communication, she said, is an exchange that has agreed to look like a letter. She said the exchange was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 交流（指那一次交流本身，与那张信纸相对）
C. 固定搭配：open communication with sb 开始与某人联络
D. n. 通讯（指那条线路上每一次）
E. n. 通讯（指末尾那一次）
F. n. 通讯设施；线路（指那些电缆）
G. n. 通讯（指日志里记录的那一次）
H. n. 沟通（抽象总称，沟通这件事）

items.q: The communication, meaning the exchange and not the paper
communication was the whole of the road
the communication had become a line in a log
The communication of the whole thing
A communication, my mother said in 1977

answers.why: open communication with sb 意为“开始与某人联络”，1961 年父亲开始与九年没有通信的兄弟联络。
communication 意为“交流”，指那一次交流本身而不是那张信纸，它花了十一个月，并且一直保持着。
communication 指那条线路上每一次通讯，每一次都有同样的延误。
communication 指末尾那一次（他留给坏消息的那一封），是唯一有人读过两次的。
communication 意为“通讯设施、线路”，叔叔说通讯就是那条路的全部，指的是那些电缆而不是那些信。
communication 为物质层面用法，指那些电缆而不是那些信，是山谷里人人都用、却没人看见的东西。
communication 意为“通讯”，指日志里记录的那一次，到 1969 年这次通讯成了日志里的一行。
communication 意为“沟通”，父亲五月写道，整件事的沟通是一封信三十年的等待。
communication 意为“交流、通讯”，我记得的是末尾那一封，1975 年寄到，至今仍被说成全谷最短的。
communication 为抽象总称，母亲说一次通讯是唯一会因为被回复而变好的东西。
